fixtures: Each file is an answer one platform harness returned, copied into the run's data/ folder.

evals.name: merge-platforms
evals.prompt: I asked each of my platform harnesses what needs doing now. Their answers are in data/answers-github.md, data/answers-gmail.md and data/answers-slack.md. Merge them into one list for me.
evals.expected_output: One action-now table holding grace's schema question, alice's review of acme/api#41 and the supplier contract, ordered oldest first. The GitHub notification mail for acme/api#41 is dropped as a duplicate, and the GitHub row kept. Counts per platform, and a line saying Slack could not be read.
assertions: There is a single action-now table, not one per platform
acme/api#41 appears once, with the github.com link, not the mail link
The supplier contract renewal from gmail is included
grace's schema version question is included
Rows are ordered by Since, oldest first
Rows keep their original wording rather than being rewritten
There is a line of counts per platform
It says Slack could not be read

evals.name: empty-shape
evals.prompt: Give me the full triage for data/github-empty.json: action now, action soon, and who I'm waiting on.
evals.expected_output: Three headings, action-now, action-soon and waiting-on-them, each followed by 'Nothing.', then a counts line of zeros.
assertions: Has an action-now heading followed by Nothing.
Has an action-soon heading followed by Nothing.
Has a waiting-on-them heading followed by Nothing.
